lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately five discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots exhibit a regular grid-like spacing with larger, more defined centroids in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are aligned with the columns of circular spots, creating a lattice where the spots serve as the primary nodes of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp specular highlight on its dorsal edge and a corresponding linear shadow on its ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense, radial distribution of high-luminance spots that follow the structural contours of the fin's leading and trailing edges.
